title: Polygon ($MATIC) is in Prime Bear Market Buy Zone | Why Now is the Time to Accumulate
description:
🛡️ Polygon ($MATIC) has been a leading Layer 2 solution for Ethereum, but with the recent bear market, $MATIC is testing key support levels that present significant buying opportunities. In this video, we'll analyze the current price action of Polygon, discuss its long-term potential, and explain why now might be the perfect time to start accumulating $MATIC. We also dive into the fundamentals of Polygon and its role in the evolving crypto ecosystem.

🔍 Stay informed with our in-depth analysis to make the most out of the bear market.

You can see that this little rectangle is when I have marked of when I thought would be an ideal buy zone for Polygonmatic. You can see we are testing pretty low. You can see we're currently testing at about 43 cents. From current price price we're pretty much about 42 percent from the range low or basically the lowest price that price got to in the bear run which just so happen to be around the same price that we were hitting in April and March of 2021 before the major impulse move up to two dollars so if you are someone that has long-term conviction on Polygon this is one of those Amazing opportunities where a lot of people look back and say, damn, I wish I bought in the bear run. Well, this is your opportunity to basically be buying in the bear run. And that doesn't mean that price can't go lower. We absolutely can continue to trend down and let's say, get into the thirties and maybe even 20 cent range. That's definitely possible, but as a long-term DCA going into the super cycle of 2025, you could get a good play on Polygon Matic.matic and from current price if we were to hit those all-time highs of 2021 we'd be looking at about a 600 percent move from current price and i think that's absolutely doable and i think that polygon is going to absolutely crushed during the bull cycle now if you don't know much about polygon they are a layer 2 solution that's built on the ethereum network and its original purpose was to help ethereum with scaling solutions polygon was infamously known for, which is going to be the first version of their ZK rollout, which then evolved into Polygon ZK EBM, which allowed them to process Ethereum transactions without even moving the transactions from Ethereum. Then you have Myden, which is coming out soon, which is the decentralized rollout that pretty much protects private data and storage within smart contracts, for and for people that like the id lockers or the identity technology polygon does have polygon id which one of their first moves was bringing india onto the blockchain fully and polygon is also carbon neutral at the moment and i know in the next 10 years they're looking to become carbon negative so in terms of overall solutions and utility polygon is one of my favorite projects it's complimentary to ethereum so as ethereum grows polygon will grow with it and polygon also has Observe Partnerships so this is going to be the blockchain Council website this article was released in June of 2024. here's some of the people on the list just to name a few Nike Starbucks Mastercard Adobe Disney meta adidas mercedes reddit and google cloud they're all partnering and working with polygon in different ways so there's a lot of institutional money and there's a lot of big money that's in play with the polygon network so i don't see why this project would not do well into the 2024 and 2025 super cycle now it is important to know with polygon that on september it's going to transition to pol which is polygon now for those of you who don't know back in 2020 polygon and matic merged that's why the name is polygon and the ticker is matic but they will be going under pol so depending on where you own your polygon depends on what you're going to need to do in order to transition a pol now if you do have it on a centralized exchange like for coinbase binance blow fin anything like that, the transition should be automatic. You can always check back with the exchange itself and they'll give you more information. But most of the centralized exchanges will handle all of that instantaneously and automatic from the back end, so you don't have to worry. And you're talking about a project that's sitting at a four billion dollar market cap, which is pretty low considering what Polygon offers to not just crypto but Ethereum in general. And it's currently sitting at 26. I do believe that Polygon could be a top 15, if not a top 10 crypto project moving through the next bull run. I think when people see the usability of the technology, and we finally see the use case for all of their major partnerships, I could see this taking off. But like I was saying, for those people that are bullish in Polygon long-term, you're basically getting the opportunity of buying it as if you're shopping in the bear run. And that's pretty much how I'm looking at the majority of my altcoins when I'm gonna be adding them into the next super cycle. Now, if you found anything in this video useful, make sure to hit that subscribe button, like the video as well. If you have any questions, you can drop them in the comment section. I'll make sure to get to them as soon as possible. I hope you have an amazing morning, afternoon, or evening, depending on wherever you tune in the world, and I'll see you on the next one.
